candidates.reason: Retained the parent’s validated COUNT() aggregation and changed the day predicate from <= 7 to < 8. Integer day extraction preserves NULL handling and anomalous dates without restricting month or year.
candidates.sql: SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT() AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) < 8 GROUP BY 1, 2
